svg.desc: Nestle Production Building LOCATION Kalioub, Egypt CLIENT Best Cheese Company- Nestle COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2012 400,000 Euro DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Construction, renovation and modification of the yogurt building - Kalioub factory. BECT's scope included detailed drawings, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered landscape design, architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
